COMMODITY_TANKER_FLOWS.metric: Crude Oil Price Shock & Equity Margin Transmission

Oil/Gas (Exploration & Production).mechanism: Direct top-line revenue realization expands net cash flow per barrel without immediate operating cost inflation.

Oil/Gas (Refining & Distribution).mechanism: Crack spread expansion offsets crude slate acquisition costs.

Specialty Chemicals & Adhesives (Pidilit.mechanism: Vinyl Acetate Monomer (VAM) and petrochemical resin feedstock costs rise with 0.72 elasticity; consumer retail price hikes lag raw materials by 3-6 months.

Structural Steel Tubes (APL Apollo).mechanism: Bunker fuel and inland freight diesel costs increase per tonne; high 20-day inventory turnover cushions pass-through.

Power Cables & Infrastructure (KEI Indus.mechanism: PVC/XLPE polymer insulation compounds rise; institutional EPC contracts feature price escalation clauses mitigating ~70% of impact.

Aviation & Air Freight.mechanism: Aviation turbine fuel represents 35-42% of operating costs; ticket fare elasticity limits immediate pass-through.

Macro CPI Inflation & Discount Rate (WAC.mechanism: +$10/bbl crude drives +35 bps headline CPI inflation, pushing central bank yields and 10Y Rf by +25 bps, elevating baseline WACC from 8.74% to 8.99%.

evidence.column_used: Chapter 3: Input Cost Pass-Through & Margin Elasticity

COMMODITY_TANKER_FLOWS.interpretation: Empirical transmission matrix linking physical tanker flow disruptions to commodity prices and equity DCF values. A +$10/bbl crude oil shock compresses Pidilite EBITDA margin by -180 bps (-8.4% DCF fair value) while expanding Upstream E&P EBITDA margin by +250 bps (+14.2% DCF fair value) and lifting systemic WACC by +25 bps.
